what: A big pinned image sits large at the very top, scaled 1.35 and pushed 18% left. After just 10px of scrolling it shrinks to .75 scale over 1.2s and settles in place beside the text column, then grows back the same way on return to top — it toggles between two states, at top or not, rather than following scroll amount

options.top: Top size, default 1.35 · topx top sideways shift (xPercent), default −18
options.rest: Size after lowering, default .75 · restx side push after lowering, default 0
options.gap: Distance that counts as moved down (px), default 10
options.ease: Curve, default power1.out (GSAP default) — the original’s scene 2 uses power1.inOut

from.where: index.js .tn-mv__pics (original .mv__pictures — scroll >10px means xPercent 0 · scale .75, at the very top (ZERO) xPercent −18 · scale 1.35, 1.2s GSAP default curve. Phone is −22 · 1.1 ↔ −24 · 1.2)

note: Pinning is done by the user with position: fixed — the part only changes size and side offset
